extension.valueMarkdown: This example of a *US Core Nutrition Order Profile* illustrates a whole food diet ordered for general health promotion. The diet type is recorded as text because the bound FHIR R4 diet-type value set does not include a specific coded concept for "whole food diet."

oralDiet.instruction: Emphasize minimally processed foods. Include vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes, and lean proteins. Avoid added sugars and ultra-processed foods.
